payload.core_composition_summary: Sort reductions by potential decrease, greedily select largest per cost type, then two-pointer scan prefix sums for optimal cost.
payload.rationale: Sorting enables greedy selection; two-pointer scan efficiently finds minimal total cost combining cost-1 and cost-2 edges.
